statement.zh: Mallowan《尼姆鲁德及其遗存》（1966，两卷）是英国伊拉克考古学校对卡尔胡发掘的正式综合报告。
statement.en: Mallowan’s Nimrud and Its Remains (1966, 2 vols.) is the British School of Archaeology in Iraq primary synthesis of the Kalhu excavations.
